recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: marine fog swallowing street edges on a spring morning
a free storefront gift unmasked as hidden teeth
labs sketching faster shields against a familiar fever silhouette
long may evenings stretching daylight toward supper
side-project keystrokes gone whisper-quiet against the tide

composer-2-fast.concept: Echo-bloom catcher: blossom shards fall in doubled stutter rhythms; collect only when the phantom echo flashes, letting mist-wrong pickups pass.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Timing-aligned collect vs ignore on a drifting lane.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Hold to slide a basket horizontally; release to plant a pulse that accepts the correct beat window.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Each round locks a clean chorus-length loop when you nail the streak without fogging your combo meter.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Layers add off-beat decoys and wind shear that bends fall lines.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Monochrome Fogust bay with magenta afterimages and vinyl crackle sparks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Genre greenhouse: seedlings sprout labeled only by color; drag watering bands that crossfade playlists until each plant hears its true soil (house roots vs Nordic pop peat).
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Drag tinted ribbons between beds; pinch to splice hybrid genres into neutral compost.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Every cleared bed blooms a holographic cassette that plays a silent score tick up.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Decoy palettes mimic two genres at once until you split them with timed cuts.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Glass greenhouse dusk, holographic cassette leaves, beaded condensation UI

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Beacon scratchpad: scribble one glowing path during a lightning blink, then drag a firefly puck along memorized curvature while fog rolls back phantom walls.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Draw path with finger; afterward steer the puck by sliding along constrained tangents.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Surviving a loop without lifts unlocks brighter buoys worth one extra scribble refill.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Light pulses shorten and decoy docks mirror your last safe route.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Etched sapphire glass overlays on charcoal fog and pier sodium lamps

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Thermophone fling: loft temperature droplets through fog strata; merges score when Celsius bands align, turbulence cracks mismatched pairs.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Physics flick with merge scoring and hazard convection.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Flick blobs along parabolic arcs; tap to fracture an unstable knot before splashdown.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Chaining merges paints a skylight stripe that visibly burns the fog back for bonus depth.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Shear layers rotate mid-air and phantom isotherms invert gravity hints.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: NOAA pastel charts colliding with ink-wash sunsets over the waterfront
